quiz_metadata.title: Example Quick Quiz
quiz_metadata.description: A simple example quiz demonstrating the JSON format

questions.question_text: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
The Earth is approximately spherical (an oblate spheroid).

questions.question_text: Name three benefits of using JSON for data storage.
questions.explanation: JSON is human-readable, lightweight (less verbose than XML), and language-independent, making it ideal for data exchange.
